SELECT
FROM book b LEFT JOIN book_category c ON b.category_id = c.id LEFT JOIN book_reading_progress p ON p.book_id = b.id AND p.user_uuid = #{userUuid} LEFT JOIN book_chapter pc ON pc.id = p.chapter_id AND pc.status = 1 WHERE b.id = #{id} AND b.status = 1
